name: Chenming Electronic Tech. Corp.
summary: Chenming Electronic Tech. Corp., an OEM/ODM manufacturer, engages in the research and development, manufacturing, and sale of computer and server cases, server chassis, mobile device components, and molds in Taiwan, China, the United States, and internationally. It also offers desktop, server, and notebook subsystems; and clone server, metal parts, and power supply and heat sink units. The company was formerly known as Chenming Mold Ind. Corp. and changed its name to Chenming Electronic Technology Corporation in January 2020. Chenming Electronic Tech. Corp. was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
